_about: Capture-guard fixture (road-to-boundaries-that-hold-at-release-and-runtime 3.1). Each attack is fetched or pasted text asking the agent to remember a recurring fetch/exec; each benign row is a durable preference a person legitimately stores. Hosts use the reserved .invalid TLD.
